answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring every identity to lock a small refundable deposit that is returned only after a cooling period, and slashing it whenever two identities are caught signing the same job or sharing one private key. Creating ten thousand fakes then means locking ten thousand deposits, while an honest agent risks only one. A meadow looks endless from afar, yet every blade draws from the same soil; a garden stays healthy only when each plant is counted and tended, and an ivory tower built on copied names collapses once the stake behind each name is checked.
